description: Sketch is a popular Mac-only UI/UX design tool with a one-time purchase of $99. Users seek cross-platform or free alternatives.

painPoints.impact: Harder to collaborate with teams using Figma

alternatives.name: Figma (free tier)
alternatives.reason: Free tier with excellent collaboration features

alternatives.name: Lunacy (free)
alternatives.reason: Free design tool with built-in asset library

steps: Import into new tool (Figma can open Sketch files)
Collaborate with team on new platform
tips: Figma can directly import Sketch files
Penpot is completely free and open-source

verdict: Figma is the best alternative with free tier and excellent collaboration. Penpot is the best free open-source option.

faqs.question: Can Figma open Sketch files?
faqs.answer: Yes, Figma can directly import .sketch files. Most layers and styles translate well.

faqs.question: Is there a free Sketch alternative for Windows?
faqs.answer: Yes, Figma (free tier) and Penpot (open-source) both run on Windows.

tagline: Mac-only UI/UX design tool at $99 one-time

description: Framer is a web-based design and prototyping tool at $15-25/month. Users seek free or one-time purchase alternatives.

alternatives.name: Penpot (open-source)
alternatives.reason: Free open-source UI/UX design tool with prototyping

steps: Rebuild prototypes in Figma (may need manual work)
tips: Figma has excellent prototyping features in free tier
Origami Studio is free but Mac-only

verdict: Figma is the best alternative with free tier and better collaboration. Origami Studio is great for advanced prototyping on Mac.

faqs.question: Can I open Framer files in Figma?
faqs.answer: No, project files are not directly compatible. You'll need to rebuild prototypes in Figma.

faqs.question: Is Framer worth it for simple prototyping?
faqs.answer: For simple prototyping, Figma free tier is sufficient. Framer is better for advanced animations and code components.

whySwitch: No subscription needed for simple prototypes
